title: NewRelic Crash Reporting is buggy and causes frequent app restarts
symptom: Frequent app restarts on various devices and Android versions, increased battery consumption, and an error in the log: 'java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'void com.newrelic.agent.android.harvest.HarvestTimer.setPeriod(long)' on a null object reference'. Logcat shows restart of the whole app and tries to recreate the database tables frequently. On LineageOS 17.1, a message appears about every minute that xDrip is not responding, wait or close the app.
cause: The crash reporting change from Fabric to NewRelic (commit c6c289d) is buggy and causes the app restarts.
fix: Disabling 'Automatic Crash Reporting' makes the messages disappear but the app still restarts frequently. The issue was possibly fixed by commit ebba2d8, but it is not confirmed. The thread ends with a comment that the problem should not happen unless the app is being installed frequently, and the issue is closed.
evidence_quote: If I disable "Automatic Crash Reporting", messages disappear but the app still restarts frequently.
